source_refs.note: Exercise 4.2, Question 4: Cofactors and determinants of A and B, parts (i)-(ii) (book page 60).

blocks.explanation:
Yeh cofactor ka sawal hai. Yaad rakhein: chhota \(a_{ij}\) entry hai, aur bara \(A_{ij}\) us entry ka cofactor (sign wala minor) hai; dono alag cheezein hain.
Teeno maange gaye cofactors column 3 ke hain, is liye baad mein \(|A|\) bhi column 3 ke along nikalenge, taake mehnat dobara na karni pare.
Plan: chhupao, minor nikalo, sign \((-1)^{i+j}\) lagao; phir \(|A| = a_{13}A_{13} + a_{23}A_{23} + a_{33}A_{33}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ -2 & -2 & 7 \end{bmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(A_{13}, A_{23}, A_{33}\) aur \(|A|\).
Tareeqa: \(A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}\). Minor \(M_{ij}\) woh \(2 \times 2\) determinant hai jo row \(i\) aur column \(j\) chhupane ke baad bachta hai. \(i + j\) even ho to sign plus, odd ho to minus.

Cofactor \(A_{13}\) (row 1, column 3 chhupayein)
\[A_{13} = (-1)^{1+3}\begin{vmatrix} 0 & -5 \\ -2 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= +[(0)(-2) - (-5)(-2)]\]
\[= 0 - 10 = -10\]
Kyun: \(1 + 3 = 4\) even hai, sign plus. \((-5)(-2) = +10\), aur us ko minus kiya.
Dhyan dein: Minor chhupane se banta hai, sign position se aata hai. Pehle minor poora nikalein, phir sign lagayein; entry \(-3\) ka apna sign yahan kaam nahi aata.

Cofactor \(A_{23}\) (row 2, column 3 chhupayein)
\[A_{23} = (-1)^{2+3}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ -2 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= -[(1)(-2) - (2)(-2)]\]
\[= -[-2 + 4] = -2\]
Kyun: \(2 + 3 = 5\) odd hai, is liye bahar minus. Pehle bracket ke andar \(2\) aaya, phir minus laga kar \(-2\).
Dhyan dein: Sign hamesha minor nikalne ke baad lagayein, warna do minus aapas mein uljhte hain.

Cofactor \(A_{33}\) (row 3, column 3 chhupayein)
\[A_{33} = (-1)^{3+3}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= +[(1)(-5) - (2)(0)] = -5\]
Kyun: \(3 + 3 = 6\) even, sign plus.

Column 3 ke along \(|A|\)
\[|A| = a_{13}A_{13} + a_{23}A_{23} + a_{33}A_{33}\]
\[= (-3)(-10) + (0)(-2) + (7)(-5)\]
\[= 30 + 0 - 35 = -5\]
Kyun: Determinant = kisi bhi column ki entries \(\times\) unhi ke cofactors ka jama. Signs pehle hi cofactors ke andar hain, dobara mat lagayein.

Tasdeeq (row 2 ke along)
\[|A| = (-5)(+1)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & -3 \\ -2 & 7 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= -5(7 - 6) = -5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row 2 hai \(0, -5, 0\); sirf \(a_{22} = -5\) bachta hai, sign plus. Doosre raste se bhi \(-5\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Part (i) ke liye answer key mein \(A_{13} = -3,\ A_{23} = 0,\ A_{33} = 7\) likha hai. Yeh cofactors nahi, balkay \(A\) ki entries \(a_{13}, a_{23}, a_{33}\) hain. Sahi cofactors: \(A_{13} = -10,\ A_{23} = -2,\ A_{33} = -5\). Key ka \(|A| = -5\) sahi hai. Sabaq: chhota \(a_{ij}\) (entry) aur bara \(A_{ij}\) (cofactor) kabhi mix na karein.

blocks.explanation:
Phir cofactors: \(B_{3j}\) row 3, column \(j\) wali entry ka cofactor hai.
Teeno row 3 ke hain, to \(|B|\) row 3 ke along nikalenge.
Plan: teen cofactors (signs \(+,\,-,\,+\)), phir \(|B| = b_{31}B_{31} + b_{32}B_{32} + b_{33}B_{33}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(B = \begin{bmatrix} -5 & -2 & 5 \\ -3 & -1 & 4 \\ -2 & -1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(B_{31}, B_{32}, B_{33}\) aur \(|B|\).
Tareeqa: \(B_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}\), phir row 3 ke along expansion. Is matrix mein bohat se negative numbers hain, is liye har product bracket mein likhein.

Cofactor \(B_{31}\) (row 3, column 1 chhupayein)
\[B_{31} = (-1)^{3+1}\begin{vmatrix} -2 & 5 \\ -1 & 4 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= +[(-2)(4) - (5)(-1)]\]
\[= -8 + 5 = -3\]
Kyun: \(3 + 1 = 4\) even, sign plus. Row 3 aur column 1 chhupane ke baad rows 1, 2 aur columns 2, 3 ki entries bachti hain: \(-2, 5, -1, 4\).

Cofactor \(B_{32}\) (row 3, column 2 chhupayein)
\[B_{32} = (-1)^{3+2}\begin{vmatrix} -5 & 5 \\ -3 & 4 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= -[(-5)(4) - (5)(-3)]\]
\[= -[-20 + 15] = 5\]
Kyun: \(3 + 2 = 5\) odd, sign minus. Bracket \(-5\) aaya, minus lagne se \(+5\).

Cofactor \(B_{33}\) (row 3, column 3 chhupayein)
\[B_{33} = (-1)^{3+3}\begin{vmatrix} -5 & -2 \\ -3 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= +[(-5)(-1) - (-2)(-3)]\]
\[= 5 - 6 = -1\]
Kyun: Sign plus. Dono products positive hain (\(5\) aur \(6\)), aur un ka farq \(-1\).

Row 3 ke along \(|B|\)
\[|B| = b_{31}B_{31} + b_{32}B_{32} + b_{33}B_{33}\]
\[= (-2)(-3) + (-1)(5) + (2)(-1)\]
\[= 6 - 5 - 2 = -1\]
Kyun: Row 3 ki entries \(\times\) unhi ke cofactors. Isi liye humne pehle row 3 ke cofactors nikale the: ab \(|B|\) ke liye koi naya minor nahi nikalna para. Exam mein yeh chhota rasta waqt bachata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Part (ii) ke liye answer key mein \(B_{31} = -2,\ B_{32} = -1,\ B_{33} = 2\) likha hai. Yeh cofactors nahi, balkay \(B\) ki entries \(b_{31}, b_{32}, b_{33}\) hain. Sahi cofactors: \(B_{31} = -3,\ B_{32} = 5,\ B_{33} = -1\). Key ka \(|B| = -1\) sahi hai. Sabaq: chhota \(a_{ij}\) aur bara \(A_{ij}\) kabhi mix na karein.
